column2: Dev world active: the MCP is %s, a server on this machine. Unset GELDAR_DEV_MCP_URL to turn it off.
GELDAR_DEV_MCP_URL must be exactly http://host.docker.internal:PORT/p/%s with PORT from 1024 to 65535. Fix it or unset it.
GELDAR_DEV_MCP_URL names one player's world. Start one player at a time while it is set.
